# onnx2pytorch

> onnx2pytorch (`pip install onnx2pytorch`) is an independent project, not related to onnx2torch.

onnx2pytorch converts an ONNX model into a PyTorch module. It is an earlier maintained project with a complete operator set: 203 of 203 default-domain operators in ONNX 1.23.2, and 202 of 202 in ONNX 1.22.0 (`onnx.defs.get_all_schemas`), have an explicit converter. Supported operators: https://github.com/Talmaj/onnx2pytorch/blob/master/ONNX_OPERATOR_CHECKLIST.md

## Install

```
pip install onnx2pytorch
```

## Usage

```python
import onnx
from onnx2pytorch import ConvertModel

onnx_model = onnx.load(path_to_onnx_model)
pytorch_model = ConvertModel(onnx_model)
```
